prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1126; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you reported. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was driving in the middle lane on the freeway in Houston, heading toward the downtown exit. Traffic was moving slowly, so I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the right lane. As I started to merge, a silver sedan came up on my right and sideswiped the passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the sedan before it made contact with you?

A: Not really. I glanced at my right mirror, but I didn't see it clearly. I think it was in my blind spot until I started moving over.

Q: Where were you looking when the impact happened?

A: I was looking ahead and checking my mirror again. The contact happened quickly, and I felt my car get pushed.

Q: Did you or the other driver brake or swerve before the collision?

A: I braked a little and tried to steer back into my lane. I don't think the other driver braked at all.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I grabbed the steering wheel hard and landed on my left wrist when the airbag deployed. At the hospital they told me the wrist was fractured, and I'm now wearing a splint.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: I was taken by ambulance to the emergency room, and I've been seeing an orthopedic doctor since then.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want the repairs and medical bills taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
